list: Official 55 trophies, cross-checked 2026-11-20 against Exophase and PSNProfiles (both agree with the kit's frozen list on every name, description and grade). PSN targets from PSNProfiles. Hidden flags: 28 trophies whose descriptions would spoil the story, as PSN hides them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is no separate task here. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then side strands, activities, collectibles, combat and the open-world cleanup — and treat the gold 'A Long Road' (100% completion) as the last big gate before this one. Check the Roadmap tab to see which phase is holding you back.
steps: Finish every other trophy in this guide.
Watch the platinum unlock automatically once the 54th trophy pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, so you cannot miss it: play 'Gone Fishing' from the start of the game and finish it. It teaches the basic movement, driving and fishing controls, and the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. If you are replaying, it is the first mission in the story list.
steps: Start the game and play the opening mission 'Gone Fishing'.
Follow the on-screen prompts through the fishing sequence.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the results screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 is the first block of story missions. Just keep playing the story in order — every mission in the chapter counts toward it, and the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. There is nothing to grind here; the chapter is linear, so follow the mission markers on the map.
steps: Play the story missions in order.
Finish the last mission of Chapter 1.
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 continues the story and opens up more of Leonida. Play its missions in order; the trophy is awarded for finishing the chapter, not for any single task inside it. Use the downtime between missions to try activities and pick up collectibles you pass, so the later grind is shorter.
steps: Play the story missions of Chapter 2 in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 takes the story into Vice City itself. As with the earlier chapters, the trophy comes from finishing the chapter, so keep following the story markers. By now the map is largely open — if a mission asks for a specific vehicle or weapon, buy it between missions rather than mid-mission.
steps: Play the story missions of Chapter 3 in order.
Finish the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the last full chapter before the finale. Finish its missions in order and the trophy pops at the end of the chapter. Before you push into the final mission, use this chapter to clear side strands and meditation spots, because the finale can lock some open-world access behind it.
steps: Play the story missions of Chapter 4 in order.
Clear side strands and meditation spots before the finale if you can.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is for finishing the game's final mission. There is only one way to get it: play the story through to the end. Make a manual save before you start the finale, stock up on armour and ammo, and take the mission at your own pace — the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen, right before the credits.
steps: Finish Chapters 1-4.
Save manually, then start the final mission.
Complete it; the gold trophy pops at the results screen.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: 'Breakfast Run' is a named story mission. It pops when the mission is complete, like every other mission trophy in this list. Follow the mission markers, and if the mission has a driving section, keep a fast car handy before you trigger it.
steps: Reach 'Breakfast Run' in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: 'The Cartel Heist' is a big set-piece mission. It pops on completion, so the only requirement is to finish it. Heist missions usually have a setup phase first — do the setup, then run the heist itself, and keep moving during the escape so the wanted level does not catch up with you.
steps: Reach 'The Cartel Heist' in the story.
Complete any setup the mission asks for, then run the heist.
Escape and finish the mission for the trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: 'Child's Play' is a named story mission. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. There is no extra objective to chase — finishing the mission is the whole requirement.
steps: Reach 'Child's Play' in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: 'Headliners' is a named story mission. Finish it and the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. If the mission involves a performance or a crowd, follow the prompts in order rather than rushing — the mission only fails if you ignore them.
steps: Reach 'Headliners' in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: 'VCIA Takedown' is a named story mission set around the airport. Finish it and the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. Airport missions tend to have heavy wanted levels, so use cover, keep a fast getaway vehicle nearby, and do not linger in the open after the objective is done.
steps: Reach 'VCIA Takedown' in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: 'Operation Savage Glory' is a named story mission. Finish it and the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. The name suggests a large combat section, so go in with full armour, a good rifle, and a vehicle you can leave in quickly.
steps: Reach 'Operation Savage Glory' in the story.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the long grind behind the platinum: reach 100% completion on the in-game stats page. That means the full story, every side strand, all collectibles, activities and the counts in this guide. Track your percentage in the pause menu as you go, and use this guide's checklist to find the categories that are still short — the last few percent are almost always collectibles.
steps: Finish the story and every side strand.
Complete all collectibles, activities and counted tasks in this guide.
Check the in-game completion percentage; at 100% the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 250 stunts, so this silver is a grind, not a skill test. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime the game counts as you drive — the counter ticks up during normal play, especially if you drive fast and take ramps. The fastest route is to repeat a good jump spot: a long straight with a ramp, a fast car, and a clean landing. Do a few stunts between missions from the start and the total will be close to 250 by the end of the story.
steps: Drive fast and take jumps, ramps and near-misses whenever you travel.
Repeat a reliable jump spot for clean landings.
Watch the PSN counter; at 250 the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 9 activity types, and you only need to try each one once — no wins required. Work through the activities list in the pause menu: fishing, races, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and one more of the open-world pastimes. One attempt at each is enough, so this is a quick tour rather than a grind.
steps: Open the activities list in the pause menu.
Try each of the 9 activity types once.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 42 Shooting Range challenges, and this silver needs a gold medal in every one of them. Go weapon by weapon: learn each challenge's target pattern first with a slow run, then push for gold. Use the weapon the challenge is built for, aim for headshots where the scoring rewards them, and replay a challenge immediately while the pattern is fresh in your head.
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenges list.
Work through the 42 challenges weapon by weapon.
Earn gold in each; the trophy pops on the 42nd gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 14 drone-race locations, and you need a win at each one. Drone races are short, so the challenge is learning each course's corners rather than raw speed. Fly the practice line once, then race: cut corners where the gates allow it, and do not crash on the final stretch — a crash costs more time than a cautious line saves.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win the race there, then move to the next location.
Win at all 14 locations for the trophy.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 20 different races, so repeats do not count — you need 20 distinct race events won. Pick the easiest class first and a car you know, and work through the race list in the pause menu, ticking each one off. Short city circuits are the fastest wins; save the long highway races for when your car is upgraded.
steps: Open the races list and pick an unwon race.
Win it with a car suited to that race type.
Win 20 different races; the trophy pops on the 20th.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival, and this trophy is for beating him in a fishing challenge. Enter a fishing challenge where Cal is the opponent, then out-fish him: cast where the fish are showing, keep the line tension in the safe zone, and reel steadily instead of yanking. One win is all it takes.
steps: Go fishing and find a challenge against Cal.
Out-fish him by keeping tension steady and reeling smoothly.
Win the challenge for the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade and finish any one arcade game to completion. It does not matter which game you pick or how high you score — finishing it is the requirement. Pick the shortest game on the list if you want this done fast, and play it through to its end screen.
steps: Find an arcade in Leonida.
Start any arcade game.
Play it through to its end screen; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the side characters with a mission strand. Play his missions in order until his final one, then complete it — the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. Side strands unlock as the story progresses, so if Andy has no mission available, push the story forward a little and check back.
steps: Play Andy's mission strand in order.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton is one of the side characters with a mission strand. Play his missions in order until his final one, then complete it — the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. If his marker is not on the map, advance the story; side strands open up chapter by chapter.
steps: Play Kenton's mission strand in order.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy is one of the side characters with a mission strand. Play his missions in order until his final one, then complete it — the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. His strand is bike-flavoured, so keep a good motorcycle handy for his missions.
steps: Play Billy's mission strand in order.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 8 stranger mission strands, and this silver needs all eight finished. Strangers appear as '?' markers across Leonida — talk to them, play their strand through, and move on to the next. There are more than eight strangers in the state, so you can skip any strand you dislike and finish eight others instead.
steps: Find '?' stranger markers across Leonida.
Complete a stranger's full mission strand.
Finish 8 strands; the trophy pops on the eighth.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy is one of the side characters with a mission strand. Play his missions in order until his final one, then complete it — the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. His missions revolve around supply runs, so a fast car with good handling helps.
steps: Play Randy's mission strand in order.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone is one of the side characters with a mission strand. Play his missions in order until his final one, then complete it — the trophy pops on the mission-complete screen. If his marker is not showing, advance the story a mission or two and check the map again.
steps: Play Tyrone's mission strand in order.
Reach and complete his final mission.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 18 meditation spots, and this is the ONE trophy in the game to watch for missing: meditation spots are scattered across Leonida, and the safest plan is to meditate at every spot you pass while you explore, well before the final mission. Do them as you go — start in Chapter 1 and clear each area's spots before you move on. The meditation prompt appears when you stand on a spot, so walk the scenic viewpoints and quiet corners, not just the roads.
steps: Meditate at every spot you find while exploring, starting in Chapter 1.
Clear each area's spots before moving on.
Finish all 18 spots before the final mission; the trophy pops on the 18th.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret asks you to hunt a unique animal. Take the hunt when it is offered, track the animal to its area, and take the shot cleanly — a scoped rifle and patience beat rushing in. The trophy pops when the hunt is complete and you report back to Bret.
steps: Take Bret's hunt when it is offered.
Track the unique animal to its area.
Take it down cleanly and report back to Bret.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 3 collectible card sets, and this silver needs three full sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, on rooftops, in out-of-the-way corners. Pick up every card you see while exploring, and use the in-game collection menu to see which sets are one or two cards short, then hunt those specifically.
steps: Pick up collectible cards wherever you find them.
Check the collection menu for sets that are nearly complete.
Complete 3 full sets; the trophy pops on the third.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 100 WAiNK It locations — the photo-spot activity. Open the WAiNK app, find a marked location, frame the shot the app asks for and take it. Each location counts once, so work area by area and clear the map's marked spots as you explore; the app shows which locations you have already done.
steps: Open the WAiNK app and pick a marked location.
Frame and take the photo it asks for.
Do this at 100 locations; the trophy pops on the 100th.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 50 challenges, and they stack up from everything else you do: stunts, races, hunting, driving, combat. Open the challenges list in the pause menu and chase the nearly-done ones first — a challenge at 48/50 is a faster trophy than a new one at 0/50. By the time the story and activities are done, you will be most of the way there.
steps: Open the challenges list in the pause menu.
Finish the challenges closest to completion first.
Complete 50 challenges; the trophy pops on the 50th.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose it and escape. The easy way: cause trouble in a quiet area until the fourth star appears, then drive — not on foot — into the countryside or through tunnels, and stay out of the police sight cones until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner beside you is the whole requirement, so trigger it during a two-person free-roam session.
steps: Play in free roam with your partner beside you.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Lose the cops and escape; the trophy pops when the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, without ever losing your wanted level between them — the chain breaks if the stars clear. Pick three shops close together on a quiet street, hit them one after another, and keep moving: the wanted level must stay on the whole time. A fast getaway car parked outside the third shop makes the escape easy.
steps: Find three shops close together, with your partner beside you.
Rob the first shop, then the second, then the third — without losing the wanted level.
The trophy pops after the third robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 100 vehicles to discover — just get in or drive a vehicle you have never used before and it counts. The counter climbs naturally as you play, since Leonida is full of different cars, bikes, boats and trucks. To finish it off, tour the rich neighbourhoods, the docks and the airport car parks, where the rare models spawn.
steps: Drive or enter vehicles you have never used before.
Tour car parks, docks and rich neighbourhoods for rare models.
Discover 100 vehicles; the trophy pops on the 100th.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time — trigger it when five or more enemies are in front of you, then take them down before it ends. The easiest spot is a mission or gang hideout with a group clustered together: wait until they bunch up, trigger Combat Focus, and work left to right. A shotgun or SMG at close range clears five fast.
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before it ends; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is the airport, and an 'unscheduled departure' means leaving it in a vehicle that was not supposed to leave — steal a plane or a service vehicle and take off from the runway. Get onto the airfield, grab a plane, line up on a runway and take off; the trophy pops once you are airborne and clear of the airport.
steps: Get into VCIA airport.
Steal a plane on the airfield.
Take off from a runway; the trophy pops once airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the tanks, and this trophy is about dealing with them — the description's joke is the clue. Raise your wanted level to the point Rhinos roll in, then take one down with sticky explosives or a rocket launcher, or steal one and go for a drive. Either way, the trophy is tied to the Rhino encounter, so get the wanted level high and be ready.
steps: Raise your wanted level until a Rhino tank is sent in.
Take it down with explosives or a rocket launcher.
The trophy pops on the Rhino encounter.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store, go in quiet, and get out without any alarm or detection. That means no smashing the front window in view of the clerk, no camera spotting you, and no wanted level at all. Go at night when the street is quiet, keep your weapon holstered until you are inside, take the goods and walk out calmly.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and go at a quiet hour.
Rob it without tripping any alarm or being seen.
Leave with no wanted level; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 5 bank vaults, and this silver needs all five robbed with a clean escape each time. Plan each vault like a mini-heist: scope the bank, hit the vault, and have a fast car waiting outside before you go in. Five escapes in a row is the hard part — do not rush between vaults, and let your wanted level clear fully before the next one.
steps: Scope a bank and park a fast getaway car outside.
Rob its vault.
Escape cleanly, then repeat for 5 vaults total.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida. Stop one — block the road with your car or hit it with explosives — grab the cash from the back, and escape before the police close in. One successful robbery and escape is all it takes.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and take the cash from the back.
Escape the police; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 52 areas of Leonida, and you need to visit every one. The in-game map shows area names as you enter them, so the method is a road trip: drive the highways and back roads, and tick off each area name as it appears. The last few areas are usually small islands, swamp corners and mountain tops — check the map for unnamed gaps and drive into them.
steps: Drive through Leonida, watching for new area names.
Cover highways, back roads and the coast.
Visit all 52 areas; the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 9 gangs, and you need to rob an illegal operation belonging to each one. Illegal operations are marked on the map once you discover them — hit one per gang, take the goods and get out. Work through the gang list in the pause menu so you can see which gangs are still missing.
steps: Find an illegal operation on the map.
Rob it and escape.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or cocktail spot with a sea view, and order a cocktail. Sit with the view for a moment — the trophy pops once the drink is served and you are looking out over the ocean. It is a pure flavour trophy, so do it early for a breather between missions.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar with a sea view and order a cocktail.
The trophy pops once the drink is served.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive into a vehicle showroom and smash your way back out through the glass in classic style. Pick a showroom with a big front window, drive a sturdy car straight in, then floor it back out through the glass — the trophy pops on the exit. Pick a quiet hour so the police do not complicate the escape.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a big glass front.
Drive in, then smash back out through the glass.
The trophy pops on the exit.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a game through — 'follow-through' is the clue, so finish the game properly rather than quitting halfway. Aim steadily, follow through on the throw, and play all the frames to the end; the trophy pops at the end of the game.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling.
Finish all frames; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one is cryptic on purpose — 'a partnership with mass appeal' points to doing something with your partner that draws a crowd. Play co-op moments with your partner in busy public places and the trophy will come from one of them; if it has not popped by the end of the story, revisit the busy hotspots (beach, boardwalk, stadium) with your partner and try the public activities there.
steps: Play public activities with your partner in busy places.
Try the beach, boardwalk and stadium hotspots.
The trophy pops on the partnership moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 500 choices — every decision the game counts, from dialogue picks to approach choices in missions and activities. There is no shortcut: make choices constantly, in missions and in free roam, and the counter climbs. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so by the time you have done the story, the side strands and the activities, you will be close.
steps: Make choices in every mission and activity — dialogue, approaches, routes.
Keep playing; the counter is cumulative.
At 500 choices the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail something once, then succeed on the second try — that is the whole trophy. The easiest route is a mission or activity you can retry: fail it deliberately the first time, then pass it on the immediate retry and the trophy pops. Do not worry about failing — the game counts the retry, not the failure.
steps: Fail a mission or activity once.
Retry it immediately.
Pass on the second try; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Something strange is out there in Leonida, and this trophy is for witnessing it. Strange events are the game's easter eggs — odd lights, odd sounds, odd encounters in remote places. Explore the remote corners (swamps, desert roads, mountaintops) at night and the event will find you; the trophy pops when you witness it.
steps: Explore remote corners of Leonida, especially at night.
Look for strange lights, sounds or encounters.
Witness the strange event; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A 'melee drive-by' means hitting someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — drive past a pedestrian and swing as you pass, bowling them over. Find a quiet street with pedestrians, get up a little speed, and swing the bat as you pass. One clean hit is all it takes.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a pedestrian on a quiet street.
Swing the melee weapon as you pass; the trophy pops on the hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: PSN tracks $250,000 laundered. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to launder them into clean cash. Every robbery in this guide earns Marked Bills, so launder after each one instead of letting them pile up, and the total will reach $250,000 by the time the combat and heist trophies are done.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: PSN tracks $100,000 spent across all shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food, anything you buy counts. Spend as you play rather than hoarding cash: buy the weapons and armour you need, the clothes you like, and a car or two. By the end of the story you will be most of the way there; top it up with a vehicle purchase if you are short.
steps: Spend money in shops as you play — weapons, clothes, cars.
Check the PSN counter in the pause menu.
Reach $100,000 spent; the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 8 garage properties, and you need to buy them all. Garages are sold across Leonida — check the property listings, visit each one, and buy it. They are also useful: each garage stores vehicles for the 'Whip It Good' and 'On the Spot' trophies, so buy them as you find them.
steps: Check property listings for garages for sale.
Visit and purchase each garage.
Buy all 8; the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 10 vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register a vehicle you own or have just found, and repeat for ten different vehicles. The easiest ten are the cars already in your garages — register them first, then find a few more on the street.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle.
Register 10 different vehicles; the trophy pops on the 10th.
